# StudyMovie

> Self-hosted TypeScript CLI for an automatic JAV library: follows bookmarked actresses on JavDB, downloads the best magnet with aria2 on your own computer or with Thunder (迅雷) on a NAS, renames finished files to "YYYY-MM-DD CODE Actress.ext" and serves a LAN library wall. Also subscribes to TV series and anime. MIT licensed.

- Runs on: any computer with Node.js 18+ and aria2 (macOS, Linux, Windows), or a Linux NAS with systemd user services and the Thunder NAS API (tested on UGREEN UGOS).
- Download backends: aria2 JSON-RPC (default without config; the CLI starts aria2c itself) or Thunder on a NAS over SSH.
- Metadata: public JavDB app endpoints and javdb.com movie pages; no JavDB account.
- Magnets: javdb.com movie page first, sukebei RSS fallback; queried from 1 day before release, daily for 14 days, then weekly.
- Schedule: catalog 03:00, shows check 04:00, shows organize 08:00/20:00, organize 15:00, teachers auto 18:00.
- Naming: all female cast, up to 4 names joined with 、 then 等; unknown names re-checked from cache every run.
- Failure policy: any source or submission failure exits with code 1.

- Agent install: `npm install -g --install-links github:OceanJy333/StudyMovie`, or `npx skills add OceanJy333/StudyMovie` for the skill; every command prints JSON and needs `--apply` to change anything.
